description: Per-row LLM inference via Mammouth AI's OpenAI-compatible multi-model-routing API. One API key, one endpoint; pass any underlying model name directly (gpt-5.4, claude-opus-5-5, gemini-3.8-flash, mistral-medium-3-5) or the 'mammouth-recommended' alias. Drop-in peer of openai_llm / anthropic_llm / gemini_llm / groq_llm / openrouter_llm. For local (non-gateway) multi-vendor routing use litellm_inference_asset.

outputs.description: Upstream DataFrame with the LLM response column added (and an optional _error column).

api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Mammouth API key.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

base_url.description: Mammouth OpenAI-compatible base URL. Override only for proxies.
base_url.label: Base URL

text_model.label: Text Model
text_model.description: Mammouth model id -- pass the underlying model name straight through (gpt-5.4, claude-opus-5-5, gemini-3.8-flash, mistral-medium-3-5), or 'mammouth-recommended'.

user_prompt_template.description: Template with {column} placeholders. Mutually exclusive with input_column.
user_prompt_template.label: User Prompt Template

input_column.description: Column whose value becomes the per-row prompt. Mutually exclusive with user_prompt_template.
input_column.label: Input Column

response_format.label: Response Format
response_format.description: 'json_object' for JSON-only output (supported by most underlying models).

rate_limit_delay.description: Seconds to sleep between rows. Raise this if you hit Mammouth's rate limits.
rate_limit_delay.label: Rate Limit Delay

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Useful for transient errors like network glitches or rate limits.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5'.
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

name: Mammouth LLM
